## 3dslibris 3.2.2

This update makes the One-handed controls work fully from the D-Pad when selecting links and images.

### Fixes and improvements

- [#183](https://github.com/RigleGit/3dslibris/issues/183): with the `One-handed` control scheme, the D-Pad key that starts link/image selection (`D-Pad Left` in vertical, `D-Pad Up` in horizontal) now also leaves it. Before, you had to press `B`, `Y`, `L` or `R`.
- With `One-handed`, that same D-Pad key also closes the image viewer, so you can open an image and get back to the page without leaving the D-Pad. Panning in that direction stays on the Circle Pad; the other D-Pad directions still pan. `Y` and the on-screen back button work as before, and the `Default` scheme is unchanged.
- The app now reports its version correctly (3.2.1 still showed 3.2.0).
- Updated the README.

### Downloads

- `3dslibris.cia` or `3dslibris.3dsx` for normal use.
- `3dslibris-sdmc.zip`: runtime files for Homebrew Launcher installs; use with the `.3dsx` download.
- Debug builds (`3dslibris-debug.cia` / `3dslibris-debug.3dsx`) and `3dslibris-source.tar.gz` are also included.

Thanks to everyone trying the builds and reporting issues. You can support the project with a ⭐ on GitHub or [a coffee](https://ko-fi.com/rigle).
